customer_question: Our Slack alerts stopped arriving on Friday, right after we renamed our Slack workspace. The Slack step now fails with CF-503.
resolution: Renaming the Slack workspace invalidated the connector's authorisation, so the Slack step returned CF-503 (connector unavailable). Re-authorised the Slack connector under Connectors → Slack → Re-authorise and re-selected the alerts channel in the step. Alerts resumed on the next run.
